'''2010 Malastare Regionals Nick LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Quit Making Trap
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
